en.headline: Central Kowloon Route Kowloon Bay section to open 6 December
en.dek: Transport chief Mable Chan told LegCo the last stretch of Route 6 will cut peak Tseung Kwan O to Yau Ma Tei trips to about 12 minutes.
body: The Kowloon Bay section of the Central Kowloon Route will open to traffic on 6 December, Secretary for Transport and Logistics Mable Chan told the Legislative Council Panel on Transport on Wednesday.

Together with the Yau Ma Tei section that opened at the end of last year and the Tseung Kwan O–Lam Tin Tunnel, the opening will complete Route 6. Chan said the full corridor would link West Kowloon, East Kowloon and Tseung Kwan O.

She said peak-hour driving between Tseung Kwan O town centre and Yau Ma Tei was expected to fall from about 65 minutes before Route 6 to about 12 minutes, a saving of 53 minutes. Officials have previously indicated a flat toll of HK$8 once the whole Central Kowloon Route is in service.

Chan said system testing and fire-safety inspections had been under way in recent months and that final preparations were in hand. The Yau Ma Tei section already carries about 70,000 vehicle trips a day, she noted, drawing some traffic off Lung Cheung Road and the Gascoigne Road Flyover.

zh.headline: 中九龍繞道九龍灣段12月6日通車
zh.dek: 陳美寶向立法會表示，六號幹線全面啟用後，繁忙時間將軍澳往油麻地車程料由約65分鐘減至約12分鐘。
body: 運輸及物流局局長陳美寶星期三在立法會交通事務委員會表示，中九龍繞道九龍灣段將於12月6日通車。
連同去年年底通車的油麻地段及將軍澳—藍田隧道，六號幹線將全面啟用，連接西九龍、東九龍及將軍澳。
陳美寶表示，繁忙時間由將軍澳市中心往油麻地的車程，料由六號幹線通車前約65分鐘減至約12分鐘，節省約53分鐘。當局早前表明整條中九龍繞道通車後將收取劃一8元隧道費。
她指近月已進行系統測試及消防檢查，正作最後籌備。油麻地段現時每日約有7萬車次，並已分流部分龍翔道及加士居道天橋車流。
